      "to": "TransmittingData"
    },

      "event": "timeout packet",
      "action": "set window size to half",
      "to": "WindowReduced"
    },
    {

      "event": "receive acknowledgment",
      "action": "set window size up by one",
      "to": "TransmittingData"
    },

      "from": "TransmittingData",
      "event": "cond window_size_reaches_maximum",
      "action": "stop increasing window",
      "to": "WindowIncreased"
